verses.sanskrit:
वैशंम्पायन उवाच।
              एवमुक्ताः प्रयातास्ते पाण्डवा जनमेजय। राज्ञा दक्षिणपञ्चालान्द्रुपदेनाभिरक्षितान्॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : OJanamejaya, having been thus addressed, the Pandavas proceeded towards the Southern Panchala country, uled over by the king Drupada.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेषु महात्मानं शुद्धात्मानमकल्मषम्। ददृशुः पाण्डवा वीराः पथि द्वैपायनं तदा॥२॥
verses.english: On their way of the heroic Pandavas saw the illustrious, the pure-souled and the perfectly sinless Rishi Dvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मै यथावत्सत्कारं कृत्वा तेन च सत्कृताः। कथान्ते चाभ्यनुज्ञाताः प्रययुर्द्रुपदक्षयम्॥३॥
verses.english: Duly worshipping the Rishi and being saluted by him, when their conversation came to a close, they proceeded by his command to the palace of Drupada.

verses.sanskrit: पश्यन्तो रमणीयानि वनानि च सरांसि च। तत्र तत्र वसन्तश्च शनैर्जग्मुर्महराथाः॥४॥
verses.english: Those great car-warriors slowly walked on, stopping on forests and on (the banks of) lakes which they found to be charming.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाध्यायवन्तः शुचयो मधुराः प्रियवादिनः। आनुपूर्व्येण संप्राप्ताः पाञ्चालान्पाण्डुनन्दनाः॥५॥
verses.english: The sons of Pandu, devoted in study, amiable, sweet-speeched and pure in acts, at last arrived in the country of the Panchalas.

verses.sanskrit: ते तु दृष्ट्वा पुरं तच्च स्कन्धावारं च पाण्डवाः। कुम्भकारस्य शालायां निवासं चक्रिरे तदा॥६॥
verses.english: After seeing the city and also the barracks, the Pandavas, took up there quarters in a potter's house.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र भैक्षं समाजह्रुर्ब्राह्मणीं वृत्तिमाश्रिताः। तान्संप्राप्तांस्तथा वीराञ्जज्ञिरे न नराः क्वचित्॥७॥
verses.english: Adopting the life of the Brahmanas, they begged their food there (in that city). No man recognised those heroes when they stopped there.
verses.bhavadeepa: स्कन्धावारं राजगृहप्राकारं लोकसमूहस्थानं वा । ‘स्कन्धः स्यान्नृपतावंसे साम्परायसमूहयो:’ इति मेदिनी ॥६॥

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञसेनस्य कामस्तु पाण्डवाय किरीटिने। कृष्णां दद्यामिति सदा न चतद्विवृणोति सः॥८॥
verses.english: Yajnasena always cherished the wish of bestowing (his daughter) Krishna on Kirit (Arjuna), the son of Pandu, but he never spoke it to any body.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽन्वेषमाणः कौन्तेयं पाञ्चाल्यो जनमेजय। दृढं धनुरथानम्यं कारयामास भारत॥९॥
verses.english: O Janamejaya, O descendant of Bharata, thinking of the son of Kunti (Arjuna), the Panchala king caused a very stiff bow to be made incapable of being bent by any man except Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit: यन्त्रं वैहायसं चापि कारयामास कृत्रिमम्। तेन यन्त्रेण समितं राला लक्ष्यं चकार सः॥१०॥
verses.english: Causing a machinery to be erected in the sky, the king set up a mark to be shot through that machinery.

verses.sanskrit:
द्रुपद उवाच।
              इदं सज्यं धनुः कृत्वा सज्जैरेभिश्च सायकैः। अतीत्य लक्ष्य यो वेद्धा स लब्धा मत्सुतामिति॥११॥
verses.english: Drupada said : He, who will string this bow and he who will be able to shoot the mark above the machinery with these ornamented arrows, will obtain my daughter.
verses.bhavadeepa: वैहायसम् अन्तरिक्षगतम् । यन्त्रं तीव्रवेगवत्तया भ्रमणेन लक्ष्यमार्गसङ्कोचकमन्तराबद्धं समितं यन्त्रच्छिद्रद्वारा उपलक्षितम् । लक्ष्यमपि वैहायसमित्यर्थः । अस्त्रशिक्षायाम् एकेनार्जुनेनैव चललक्ष्यपातनं कृतमतः स एव चलयन्त्रद्वारा लक्ष्यं भेत्स्येति नान्य इति । तदन्वेषणायायं यत्नो द्रुपदेन कृतः । यद्यपि कर्णस्याप्येतत्सुकरं तथापि हीनकुलत्वात्स सुपरिहर इति भावः ॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit:
वैशंपायन उवाच।
              इति स द्रुपदो राजा स्वयंवरमघोषयत्। तच्छ्रुत्वा पार्थिवाः सर्वे समीयुस्तत्र भारत॥१२॥
verses.english: came Vaishampayana said : With these words, the king Drupada proclaimed the Svaimvara. O descendant of Bharata, having heard this, all the kings came there.
verses.bhavadeepa: सज्यं धनुः कृत्वा इदं यन्त्रमतीत्य लक्ष्यं यो वेद्धा वेद्धुं समर्थः ॥११॥

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयश्च महात्मानः स्वयंवरदिदृक्षवः। दुर्योधनपुरोगाश्च सकर्णाः कुरवो नृप॥१३॥
verses.english: There came also many illustrious Rishis desirous of seeing the Svaimvara. O king, Duryodhana and the Kurus, accompanied by Karna, also came there.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽर्चिता राजगुणा द्रुपदेन महात्मना॥१४॥
verses.english: There also many illustrious, Brahmanas from many countries. The kings and princes were duly worshipped by the illustrious Drupada.

verses.sanskrit: उपोपविष्टा मञ्चेषु द्रष्टुकामाः स्वयंवरम्। ततः पौरजनाः सर्वे सागरोद्धूतनिःस्वनाः॥१५॥
verses.english: All the citizens, making a deep noise as that of the ocean, took their seats on the platforms with the desire of seeing the Svayamvara.

verses.sanskrit: शिशुमारशिरः प्राप्य न्यविशंस्ते स्म पार्थिवाः। प्रागुत्तरेण नगराद्भूमिभागे समे शुभे। समाजवाटः शुशुभे भवनैः सर्वतो वृतः॥१६॥
verses.english: The kings and princes entered the palace (of Svaimvara) through the north east gate. The arena was built on a plane and on an auspicious ground on the north east of the city. The Samajavata (arena) was surrounded by palaces and it was enclosed on all sides by a wall and a moat, it was ornamented with gates and arches and covered all over with a beautiful canopy.

verses.sanskrit: प्राकारपरिखोपेतो द्वारतोरणमण्डितः। वितानेन विचित्रेण सर्वतः समलङ्कृतः॥१७॥
verses.bhavadeepa: शिशुमारो जलजन्तुः तदाकारस्तारासमूहात्मको विष्णुः तस्य शिरः प्रदेशे ऐशान्यां दिशि । अत एव सा अपराजिता दिकू । तां दिशं प्राप्य न्यविशन् । तामेव दिशमाह प्रागिति । प्रागुत्तरेण प्रागुदीच्योरन्तराले नगरात्समीपे ।‘एनबन्यतरस्यामदूरे पञ्चम्या’ इत्येनबन्तमिदम् ॥१६॥

verses.sanskrit: तूर्यौघशतसङ्कीर्णः परार्ध्यागुरुधूपितः। चन्दनोदकसिक्तश्च माल्यदामोपशोभितः॥१८॥
verses.english: It resounded with the notes of thousands of trumpets, it was scented with Aguru (back aloe), ornamented with garlands and sprinkled with the Sandal water paste.

verses.sanskrit: कैलासशिखरप्रख्यैर्नभस्तलविलेखिभिः। सर्वतः संवृतः शुभ्रैः प्रासादैः सुकृतोच्छ्रयै॥१९॥
verses.english: It was surrounded on all sides by high and white mansions looking like the cloud-kissing peaks of the Kailasa (mountain).

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णजालसंवीतैर्मणिकुट्टिमभूषणैः। सुखारोहणसौपानैर्महासनपरिच्छदैः॥२०॥
verses.english: Their windows were covered with networks of gold and their walls set with diamonds and precious stones. Their staircases were easy of ascent and the floors were covered with rich carpets and robes.

verses.sanskrit: स्रग्दामसमवच्छन्नैरगुरूत्तमवासितैः। हंसांशुवर्णैर्बहुभिरायोजनसुगन्धिभिः॥२१॥
verses.english: They were scented with Aguru and adorned with wreaths and garlands of flowers; they were all white and spotless like the necks of the swans. Their fragrance could be perceived from a Yojana.

verses.sanskrit: असंबाधशतद्वारैः शयनासनशोभितैः। बहुधा तु पिनद्धाङ्गैर्हिमवच्छिखरैरिव॥२२॥
verses.english: Each of them contained one hundred doors wide enough to admit a crowd all at once; they were adorned with costly beds ornamented with various metals; they looked like the peaks of the Himalayas.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र नानाप्रकारेषु विमानेषु स्वलङ्कृताः। स्पर्धमानास्तदाऽन्योऽन्यं निषेदुः सर्वपार्थिवाः॥२३॥
verses.english: In them lived all the kings, adorned with various kinds of ornaments and each boasting to get possession of the maiden.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रोपविष्टान्ददृशुर्महासत्त्वापराक्रमान्। राजसिंहान्महाभागान्कृष्णागुरुविभूषितान्॥२४॥
verses.english: When those best of kings, who were adorned with the fragrant paste of Aguru, who were greatly powerful, noble minded, liberal, devoted to Brahmanas, beloved of the whole world for their good deeds and the protectors of their kingdoms, took their respective seats, the people of the city and the country who had come to see Krishna and who had already taken their seats on the excellent platforms all around saw them.
verses.bhavadeepa: विमानेषु सप्तभूमिगृहेषु । ‘विमानो व्योमयाने च सप्तभूमिगृहेपि च’ इति मेदिनी ॥२३॥

verses.sanskrit: महाप्रसादान्ब्राह्मण्यान्स्वराष्ट्रपरिरक्षिणः। प्रियान्सर्वस्य लोकस्य सुकृतैः कर्मभिः शुभैः॥२५॥
मञ्चेषु च परार्ध्येषु पौरजानपदा जनाः। कृष्णादर्शनसिद्ध्यर्थं सर्वतः समुपाविशन्॥२६॥
ब्राह्मणैस्ते च सहिताः पाण्डवाः समुपाविशन्। ऋद्धिं पञ्चालराजस्य पश्यन्तस्तामनुत्तमाम्॥२७॥
verses.english: The Pandavas sat there in the arena with the Brahmanas and saw the great affluence of the Panchala king.

verses.sanskrit: ततः समाजो ववृधे स राजन्दिवसान्बहून्। रत्नप्रदानबहुलः शोभितो नटनर्तकैः॥२८॥
verses.english: O king, that assemblage daily increased in bulk,) and it looked gay with (the performances of) actors and dancers. Large presents of wealth were also made.

verses.sanskrit: वर्तमाने समाजे तु रमणीयेऽह्नि षोडशे। आप्लुताङ्गी सुवसना सर्वाभरणभूषिता॥२९॥
verses.english: When this grand assembly continued (for 15 days,) then on the sixteenth day, O best of the Bharata race, Draupadi, having bathed, attired in the best robes and adorned with all ornaments entered the arena carrying in her hand a golden dish on which there were a garland of flowers and other offerings of the Arghya.

verses.sanskrit: मालां च समुपादाय काञ्चनीं समलङ्कृताम्। अवतीर्णा ततो रङ्गं द्रौपदी भरतर्षभ॥३०॥
पुरोहितः सोमकानां मन्त्रविद्ब्राह्मणः शुचिः। परिस्तीर्य जुहावाग्निमाज्येन विधिवत्तदा॥३१॥
verses.english: The priest of the lunar race, that holy Brahmana learned in the Mantras, kindling the sacrificial fire in all due forms poured libations of ghee.

verses.sanskrit: संतर्पयित्वा ज्वलनं ब्राह्मणान्स्वस्ति वाच्य च। वारयामास सर्वाणि वादित्राणि समन्ततः॥३२॥
verses.english: Gratifying Agni and making the Brahmanas utter the formula of benediction, he stopped all the musical instruments (that were then being played) all around.

verses.sanskrit: निःशब्दे तु कृते तस्मिन्धृष्टद्युम्नो विशांपते। कृष्णामादाय विधिवन्मेघदुन्दुभिनिःस्वनः॥३३॥
verses.english: O king, when they are became perfectly still, Dhrishtadyumna, possessing a voice like that of kettle-drums or clouds, taking hold of his sister's arm, stood in the midst of the assembly and spoke these sweet words of excellent import with a voice as that of the clouds.

verses.sanskrit: रङ्गमध्यं गतस्तत्र मेघगम्भीरया गिरा। वाक्यमुच्चैर्जगादेदं श्लक्ष्णमर्थवदुत्तमम्॥३४॥
इदं धनुर्लक्ष्यमिमे च बाणाः शृण्वन्तु मे भूपतयः समेताः। छिद्रेण यन्त्रस्य समर्पयध्वं शरैः शितैर्व्योमचरैर्दशार्धैः॥३५॥
verses.english: Dhrishtadyumna said: Hear, O you assembled kings, this is the bow, that is the mark and these are the arrows. Shoot the mark through the 'orifice of the machine with these fine sharp arrows.

verses.sanskrit: एतन्महत्कर्म करोति यो वै कुलेन रूपेण बलेन युक्तः। तस्याद्य भार्या भगिनी ममेयं कृष्णा भवित्री न मृषा ब्रवीमि॥३६॥
verses.english: Truly do I say, he who possessing noble birth, beauty and strength will achieve this great feat, shall obtain today for his wife this my sister Krishna.
verses.bhavadeepa: इदं धनुः इदं च लक्ष्यं इमे च बाणाः । चलयन्त्रच्छिद्रद्वारा युगपत्पञ्चबाणान्लक्ष्ये यः समर्पयति तस्याद्य भार्या भगिनी ममेयमिति द्वयोः सम्बन्धः व्योमचरैर्बाणैः ॥३५॥

verses.sanskrit: तानेवमुक्त्वा द्रुपदस्य पुत्रः पश्चादिदं तां भगिनीमुवाच। नाम्ना च गोत्रेण च कर्मणा च संकीर्तयन्भूमिपतीन्समेतान्॥३७॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : Having thus addressed the assembled kings, Drupada's son (Dhrishtadyumna) then spoke thus to his sister, reciting to her the names and the lineage and the achievements of those assembled potentates.
